<!-- Copilot adapter (L3). Copilot also reads AGENTS.md natively. -->
Follow `AGENTS.md` and the org rules in `.agents/org/org-rules.md`; they override everything else.
Skills are in `.agents/skills/` (installed by `npx skills`), and reviewer agents are in `.github/agents/` (installed by the bundle's `install.py`). Both come from the pinned org bundle, so never edit them here; change them in DeccansoftAITeam/agent-bundle.
